inputs: original untouched; SHA256 in input_quality_before.json and MOLA_metadata.json
HI_RISE_vertical: Mars 2000 equipotential elevation metres from embedded PDS NOTE
MOLA_vertical: GMM3 areoid IAU2000 from PDS label; not assumed exactly interchangeable with HiRISE
processing: select contiguous independent most valid ~2.4 x 3.0km patches; native 2m preserved; 30m approximate analysis by average; only cells with >=99.9% valid raw footprint retained; no sink filling smoothing NoData filling or outlier removal
roughness: population standard deviation of all 5x5 DEM heights (~150m) as sqrt(mean(z²)-mean(z)²); local relief=max-min same full-valid window
aspect: downslope azimuth clockwise from grid north, east=90; flats and invalid 3x3 -> -9999
terrain_valid: all 3x3 stencil cells valid; local relief and roughness require fully valid 5x5 neighborhood
solar_azimuth_reference: grid north, clockwise; local grid is equirectangular Mars, grid/true north may differ and has not been converted
shadow: discrete nearest-cell horizon ray tracing to max 1200m using planet local radius 3396km and curvature correction -d²/(2R). Occlusion 1, definitely ray-unoccluded in 1200m 0, missing/exit 255. This is partial horizon, not infinite-range visibility.
shadow_limitations: unknown at edge and missing data; occlusion beyond 1200m untested; subpixel obstacles excluded; MOLA not used for obstacle completion; no permanent shadow inference
self_shadow: negative surface-normal dot sun direction; independent of cast-shadow
incidence: cos of solar incidence angle on 3x3-valid local normal; NOT brightness, camera imagery, dust or reflectance
scale_note: 30m posts do not imply identical point spread function, instrument resolution, vertical error or effective resolution to NASADEM 30m
scenario_note: hypothetical Sun, not time-specific; Mars Sun can be higher than polar Moon Sun
earth_requirements: Earth NASADEM elevation incl vertical datum and CRS, native effective resolution, comparable window footprints and valid masks, identical solar geometry and shadow distance/uncertainty convention, independent comparisons after datum compatibility review
crs_note: Mars-specific equirectangular CRS with radius 3394839.8133163 m in HiRISE headers; NO Earth UTM. MOLA sphere label radius 3396000m; no forced alignment.
